text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for summer camp! It's the perfect opportunity to train, but some students seem nervous…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Matikanetannhauser smiles as brightly as ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As optimistic as ever, she gets on the bus and we head to the camp.
